item.title: Autonomous Swarms and Industrial Scalability: The Next Frontier of UAS Warfare
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
As Western defense forces pivot toward attritable mass and edge autonomy, the battle for air superiority shifts from multi-billion dollar fighters to resilient UAS swarms and industrial supply chain integrity.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Electronic warfare resiliency requires optical-flow navigation, AI target recognition, and decentralized mesh communication to operate in GPS-denied environments. [SPLIT] ⚡ Defense supply chain integrity faces escalating threats from gray-market components, counterfeit electronics, and fraudulent sub-tier contractors. item.title: Sig Sauer and the Micro-Drone Revolution on the Frontline
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Sig Sauer is mounting pistols to micro-drones. We analyze how this radical counter-UAS shift redefines frontline combat and defense supply chains.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Small-unit commanders require immediate, organic kinetic solutions to neutralize hostile reconnaissance and attack drones below traditional air defense thresholds. [SPLIT] ⚡ The convergence of infantry weaponry and autonomous flight mechanics forces a rapid reevaluation of military procurement and tactical doctrine.
